Railway

Bring applications, workers, and infrastructure into one project.

ROfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Railway provides a project-based environment for deploying applications and managing supporting infrastructure. We can configure a web service, worker, or integration backend with environment variables, health checks, and a clear deployment process. For a client, the deliverable includes the operational decisions around regions, persistence, access, and usage so a working application has an identifiable owner after launch.

Useful outputs

  • Configured services and deployment settings
  • Health-check and logging setup
  • Operational handover and recovery procedures

Where we can apply it

  • API launch: source repository → service build → health-checked public endpoint.
  • Automation backend: scheduled trigger → processing service → monitored output.
  • Product infrastructure: frontend service + backend service → controlled networking → operations handover.
01

Use case 1

Host a custom API or SaaS backend built in a supported runtime.

02

Use case 2

Deploy background processing or scheduled integration services.

03

Use case 3

Manage related service configuration and operational visibility within a project.

Inputs we need

  • Repository or container image and start command
  • Environment, persistence, and networking requirements
  • Account access and cost expectations

Delivery sequence

  • Map services and the infrastructure each one requires.
  • Configure builds, start behavior, environment variables, and persistence.
  • Verify health, logs, access, and a representative production workflow.

Expert review points

  • Confirm persistent data survives the expected service lifecycle.
  • Review resource usage, secret access, and deployment ownership.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
